UGA.note: The Act moves marriage and guardianship registration to NIRA; it states no link between birth records and the ID system.
No digital civil registration system is stated.

facts.fact: The Registration of Persons (Amendment) Act, 2024, assented 15 July 2024, amends the Registration of Persons Act, 2015 (Act 4 of 2015) to empower NIRA to administer five civil registration laws, and starts on a date the Minister appoints by statutory instrument.

UGA.note: No enrolment count or share is stated.
No number at birth is stated.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
No register keyed on the ID number is stated.
Nothing on the ID system's issuance, biometrics or certification.
No digital entry at local registration offices is stated.
